note: the newest assistant row is the draft
plain chat after a draft does not retire it
a confirmed receipt after the draft retires it
a discarded receipt after the draft retires it
a failed receipt after the draft retires it
tool rows with an empty action_outcome do not retire a draft
the newer draft replaces the older one
a newer broken draft is the live one; the good one does not come back
an email block is not a draft row and does not hide the older draft
a gated verb block is not a draft row and does not hide the older draft
six user rows after the draft retire it
five user rows after the draft keep it live
a hidden draft row is skipped
a streaming draft row is skipped
a chat with no action block has no live draft
an unclosed fence is not a draft
an update draft stays live through chat
hidden user rows and hidden receipts after the draft are skipped
an unreadable edit action is a draft row (error card)
a doc block with no verb is a draft row
a capitalised verb is read as lower case
only the first closed fence counts: email first then a create is not a draft
a block in a user row is not a draft
a receipt after the newer draft retires it and the older draft does not come back
a streaming assistant row after the draft is skipped, the draft stays live
a lone broken block is itself the live draft
a receipt before the draft does not retire it
a hidden receipt is skipped but the visible one after it retires the draft
exactly 60 rows of any role after the draft (5 user, 5 assistant, 50 plain tool rows) keep it live
61 rows of any role after the draft retire it: it may sit beyond the page a client loaded
61 rows after the draft where one is hidden: 60 count, so it stays live
a completed create_doc row with no action_outcome (a receipt from before 2026-07-17) retires the draft and no tool_call_id
a completed update_doc row with no action_outcome retires the draft too and no tool_call_id
a completed get_doc row is a read, not a write: the draft stays live
a create_doc row still pending with no outcome is a parked card, not a write: the draft stays live
a create_doc call that ended in an error wrote nothing: the draft stays live
the agent staged a gated create card after the draft: its pending card row and its own completed call row both carry a tool_call_id, so the draft stays live
an agent write that ran (completed, with a tool_call_id) and carries an outcome retires the draft through its outcome
70 tool rows directly after the draft are its own turn (the reply row took its seq at turn start): they do not count, so it stays live
10 own-turn tool rows, then 60 later rows (a user row, a reply, 58 tool rows): exactly 60 count, so it stays live
10 own-turn tool rows, then 61 later rows (a user row, a reply, 59 tool rows): 61 count, so it is retired
a receipt inside the draft's own turn (directly after it) still retires it
a parked tool draft after a typed draft retires it: the tool card is the one card
a pending tool row with no draft_card (a sensitive park from the typed draft) leaves the typed draft live
a parked tool draft and no typed draft: nothing is live
a tool draft that was cancelled keeps the old typed draft retired
a tool draft that was confirmed keeps the old typed draft retired
a tool draft superseded by an edit keeps the old typed draft retired
the reply holds a typed block and its own turn's tool rows (after it, in seq order) include a parked tool draft: the tool card is the one card
